name: Full Lung
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You grant one touched creature the ability to hold its breath longer than normal. The target instantly resets the duration it can hold its breath underwater and gains an additional number of rounds equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). The target also gains +4 bonus to Constitution checks to avoid drowning.
